For principal infinite kernel H, an off-diagonal relation and free ultrafilter give the reverse discrepancy. Cases are exhaustive in ZFC; 28,058 finite relations independently corroborated, without claiming an infinite computational certificate.

Its exact all-cardinality boundary is finite support, and every failure has a witness among ultrafilters regardless of whether the original filter is ultra.
